description: This file is the entry point for a React application,. It imports React and ReactDOM, along with CSS styles and the main App component, then renders the App component into the DOM element with ID 'root' within a StrictMode wrapper.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root for rendering a React component tree.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders React elements into the DOM node managed by the root.
